d: Short, messy ash-blonde hair with long bangs framing the face and a small side ponytail held by a white ribbon. Sharp gold eyes with a focused, mature expression on a face reflecting a late-adolescent appearance. A slender build wearing a dark charcoal military-style coat over a white pleated skirt, a maroon waistcoat, and a white ruffled cravat, paired with dark lace-up boots. Signature details include a monocle over the right eye, gold chains wrapping around the legs, and a large, amorphous black entity with multiple red eyes and a wide grin emerging from the back.
